messages.author: 6855b04443295af7
messages.subject: RSM coding
parts:
Hey, 

I wonder if the coding for the rsm model in the mirt() is correct. 

First 13 items - 4 response options. 
Next 2 items - 3 response options
Final 13 items - 4 response options. 

block <- c(rep(1,13), rep(2,2),rep(2,13))
mirt(d3, 1, itemtype='rsm',rsm.block=block)


I get this error. 

Error: Constraint applied to fixed parameter(s) 66 70  but should only be applied to
                 estimated parameters. Please fix!


What does this mean? 
I removed the items with 3 resposne options and it works fine. Is it the way I coded the block? 

Thank you, 
Aiden

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: RSM coding
parts:
Your block should be

block <- c(rep(1,13), rep(2,2),rep(3,13))

or possibly

block <- c(rep(1,13), rep(2,2),rep(1,13))

You were correct that the block constraints had to be changed for the three category set, but your other items must also either be in the same block or another unique one. 


Phil
